outcome.technical: tools/check-report-interactive.mjs: the layout matrix no longer counts lines anywhere (barLines/rowLines/countLines/LAPTOP_BAR_LINES and the band counter are gone; grep confirms). Per cell it asks lm1/lm2 (unchanged), lm3 the count's drawn text inside its bar, lm4 the pinned stack within STACK_BUDGET for the size's class (phone 0.45, tablet 0.3, laptop 0.4, desktop 0.25 - stated once beside the matrix; viewportClass() derives the class from the size: phone where TOPBAR_SCROLLS matches in the page, else width <1024 tablet, <1600 laptop, desktop; a class no size reaches fails by name), lm5 no word of the chrome (top bar, strip, filter bar, table head, and the More-filters panel when open) drawn on two lines - a word is a run of letters/digits so breaks at spaces/hyphens are allowed, lm8 no in-flow child out of its row's content box (only the non-scrolling axis for a scrolling box), no field cut off (select vs its width holding only the chosen option, date field vs its natural width, empty search vs its placeholder, buttons/chips scrollWidth), page no wider than the screen; lm5 and lm8 again with More filters open. LAYOUT_SIZES gained 1920x1080 (desktop) and lost the `laptop` flag. The matrix comment says why a line count is not a contract. Second pass by default: WIDE_FONTS = Verdana, DejaVu Sans, Bitstream Vera Sans; the first INSTALLED font that draws a sample line wider than the page's own font is injected with page.addStyleTag(':root,*,*::before,*::after{font-family:...!important}'); every label of that pass carries `[wide font: <name>]`; the drawn font of each pass is read from the renderer (CDP CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode) and printed in a note and on a new closing line `layout matrix fonts: ...`; one expect asserts the wide pass actually draws in the named font. No candidate installed, or none wider, => the pass does not run and says `wide-font pass NOT RUN - ...` in notes and on the summary line; FEATURE_ABSENT excuses only the font-identity expect by that note (and lm5/lm8 'with More filters open' by the existing phone-panel note). Font facts measured here: Verdana sample line 426px vs 380px in the page's own font (.SF NS); DejaVu Sans is NOT installed on this machine, so Verdana-vs-DejaVu was not measurable here. CSS: controls.css .toolbar gap from token (var(--sp-1)) with a comment that wrapping onto rows is designed; #audit-q min-width calc(16ch + 2 * var(--sp-2)) - a floor that widens with the drawn font - instead of 8rem; count comment updated to the new lm ids. shell.css: .gfilters gap var(--sp-1); new .gfrange (flex, wrap, gap var(--sp-1)) so the date pair + its scope + All time wrap as one item; the scope-under-label compaction moved from (52rem < width <= 64rem) to (52rem < width < 70rem), with a dated measurement as its basis (Verdana one-row width 916-924px vs 961px of row at 64rem; at 70rem the row is 1057px), and the 9rem select cap dropped (it cut a long author off).
